backingType.note: Stablecoins + staked ETH hedged with short perp/futures positions of equal size.

attestationAgeDays.note: PROXY: monthly custodian attestations; age taken as cadence, not a specific report date.

collateralRatio.note: Fully-backed claim per protocol docs; reserve-fund cushion size not sourced this pass.

onchainRedemption.note: Mint/redeem restricted to KYC-whitelisted approved parties; retail exits via secondary liquidity. Settlement time not specified in docs.

noticeDays.note: Atomic mint/redeem for whitelisted parties; the whitelisting restriction is the real friction and is surfaced in the narrative.

singlePointsOfFailure.note: Off-exchange custody providers holding backing assets plus exchange counterparties for the hedge legs.

attestationCadenceDays.note: Monthly custodian attestations validating existence, control, and value of backing assets; PoR dashboards supplement.

docsCompleteness.note: Checklist: docs site, mechanism docs, risks section, attestations page present; redemption settlement terms not documented.
